content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P1 triggered — api-gateway (us-east-1) reporting sudden 502/504 surge, alerting on-call

alice: I’m on it. Seeing 5xx rate jump ~18% in the last 3m, p95 token latency spiking too.

ben: Can you paste the top error in the gateway logs? I’ll check runtime pools.

alice: Paste from gateway logs: 
```
ERROR upstream_request: timeout after 10s to backend model-svc-1 (10.2.3.45)
WARN connection_pool: exhausted, queued_reqs=120
```

carla: CS reporting a handful of customers see timeouts for embeddings/stream endpoints. No billing anomalies yet but customer requests failing.

alice: Quick impact numbers: ~12% of total requests failing for the last 5m, but certain customers hit 40-60% depending on traffic pattern.

ben: Looks like backend model-svc instances are slow / overloaded. Two quick mitigations: 1) circuit-break to fallback lighter model variant, 2) route heavy customers to dedicated capacity if available.

dave: I’m checking infra — connection counts on the NLB look fine, but target group health shows elevated latency. Trying a rolling restart of model-svc pods in eu-west canary to see cross-region behavior.

alice: Action list starting now: 
- throttle large clients at gateway (rate-limit header rule)
- enable model-svc fallback mapping for non-critical routes
- scale model-svc behind gateway (HPA bump)
- open temporary routing to us-west region if gateway-specific capacity saturated

ops-bot: Executing throttle policy "ingress-throttle-heavy-clients" -> applied to 3 client IP blocks.

ben: I pushed a transient config to gateway to map /v1/embeddings to model-quant-fast for non-authenticated requests (canary). Monitoring now.

alice: Confirmed: 5xx dropping to ~9% after throttle + fallback mapping. p95 down ~800ms. Still above baseline but improving.

carla: Notifying impacted customers: sending templated message to top-5 traffic owners. Will include ETA and mitigation steps.

dave: Rolling restart completed for model-svc nodes in us-east-1a. No regressions so far.

ben: One suspicious recent change: session-keepalive default lowered from 90s to 30s in last config deploy 2h ago. Reverting to 90s reduces connection churn — rolling that back now.

alice: Revert in progress. After revert + throttles + fallback, 5xx ~4.3% and falling. Latency stabilizing.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident state: mitigation in progress. Pager acknowledged by alice; on-call handover planned in 20m.

carla: Customer impact summary for post-incident note: "Transient elevated 502/504 errors for region us-east-1 due to backend saturation and connection churn after config change. Mitigations: throttling heavy clients, fallback routing to quantized model, connection-keepalive revert, and rolling restarts. Estimated customer requests affected: 0.8% of monthly volume, peak 12% over 6m window for the region."

ben: Follow-ups (to-do):
- formal RCA for keepalive config change and testing gaps
- add sentinel alert for sudden connection_pool queue growth (>=50 queued)
- add automated fallback policy for model-svc slow start

alice: Handing off to ben for overnight watch. Ben, I’ll update handoff with open actions and monitoring links.

ben: Taking over. I’m setting a 1h watch, will escalate if 5xx > 5% persists. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
